acceptanceCriteria: The gitstatus fixture disables Git auto-maintenance (or the copy tolerates a vanished lock file) so no background maintenance runs during the copy.
body: Hosted release-gates run 36338249213 (1.0.0-rc.1 candidate c9019c4b, full-gate on macos-15, 2026-09-27) failed in internal/gitstatus: TestPinnedMetadataReaderDetectsParentReplacement/symlink, status_test.go:342, `open objects/maintenance.lock: no such file or directory`. The test copies the fixture's .git with os.CopyFS while a detached Git auto-maintenance started by the fixture's own git commands creates and removes objects/maintenance.lock. Same class as V1-0351 (TestObserveWorkUsesOnlyTargetMaterialization). The test passed in #290's CI. Test-only race; product behaviour is not implicated. Blocks 1.0 through V1-0020 AC0, not rc.1.

completion.reason: Fixed in #293 (3e01eeb1). Verified on candidate b967f6bbe33c5eba367a07d7eeb2bd1e372e9162 (tree 76c65185, identical to PR head ae02388d): hosted release-gates run 36349510836 passed make gate on ubuntu-24.04 (job 108705305284) and macos-15 (job 108705305319). github.com/Beamfall/corvint/internal/gitstatus reports ok on both hosts.
